article.title: Press freedom groups oppose House Committee threat to subpoena BreakThrough News Staff
article.author: Editor
article.content: "The threatened subpoenas are clearly designed to target BreakThrough for reporting and editorial viewpoints with which the Committee disagrees," the groups declared. The post Press freedom groups oppose House Committee threat to subpoena BreakThrough News Staff appeared first on MR Online .
